text.what: Left UC Davis in 1964 with a degree and a plan to grow pinot noir outside Burgundy, and in 1965 planted it in the Willamette Valley — against the advice of every professor he had.
text.story: His 1975 Eyrie South Block Reserve placed tenth in a 1979 Paris tasting of pinot noir. Robert Drouhin ran the comparison again in Beaune in 1980, where it came second by a fraction to one of his own wines, and Burgundy took Oregon seriously from then on.

kin.as: And the first American planting of it.
